title: Choking
text: Ask: are you choking? If they can cough forcefully, encourage coughing and watch closely.
If they cannot speak, cough or breathe, give up to 5 back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of the hand.
If blows fail, give up to 5 abdominal thrusts: fist above the navel, quick inward and upward pulls.
Alternate 5 blows and 5 thrusts. If they collapse, start CPR and call for the crew medical officer.

citations.source: American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED guidance: conscious choking sequence.
